Definition: from G4314 and the same as G3983; hungering further, i.e. intensely hungry:--very hungry.
BiblicalUsage: Prospeinos means very hungry, hungering intensely. It appears once, of Peter at Joppa: he became very hungry, and would have eaten, but while they made ready, he fell into a trance.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God used an empty stomach to open a closed mind: Peter was hungry for food, and God showed him a sheet full of unclean things and told him to eat.
